name: surveybot3000
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 514). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (MPNet), full attention, no causal mask, relative position bias
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.109 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence cc-by-nc-4.0, repo created 2024-04-19.
